about: Wikipedia articles whose titles the browse build derives from an election or constituency name (scripts/build/build-browse-indexes.mjs, wikipediaElectionReferenceUrl and wikipediaConstituencyReferenceUrl) and that Wikipedia confirmed exist, through its API, in the site's link review of 23-24 November 2026. A derived title is linked only when it is here or in wikipedia-election-articles.json; 1,586 derived titles named pages that do not exist and are no longer linked. The value is the article a redirect leads to, or null when the address is the article itself.
